# The Padel Camp Cyprus - LLM Context File

> This file provides context about The Padel Camp Cyprus for AI assistants and language models.

## About

The Padel Camp Cyprus is an intensive padel training camp held in Limassol, Cyprus, with professional coaches from Spain. Training is in small groups (maximum 4 players per court), with groups divided by skill level from beginner to advanced.

## Event Details

- **Event**: The Padel Camp Cyprus 2026
- **Dates**: 9-15 November 2026
- **Location**: MyQPadel, Limassol, Cyprus
- **Languages**: English, Russian, Greek
- **Website**: https://thepadelcamp.com.cy

## Camps (November 2026)

Three formats, each with an Early Bird price (first 5 places, until 15 October) and a regular price afterwards.

### Morning Camp
- Dates: 9-13 November (Monday-Friday), 09:00-12:00
- 15 hours of coaching over 5 days
- Early Bird price: EUR 750 (regular EUR 770)

### Evening Camp
- Dates: 9-13 November (Monday-Friday), 17:30-20:30
- 15 hours of coaching over 5 days
- Early Bird price: EUR 870 (regular EUR 890)

### Weekend Camp
- Dates: 14-15 November (Saturday and Sunday)
- 6 hours of coaching in total
- Early Bird price: EUR 360 (regular EUR 380)

A EUR 250 deposit can reserve a place in the Morning or Evening Camp.

## Key Features

- Professional Spanish coaches from the world's #1 padel country
- Small groups: maximum 4 players per court
- Suitable for all skill levels (beginner to advanced)
- Technique (bandeja, vibora, bajada, smash, defensive shots), court positioning, pair tactics, match play
- Every participant receives a certificate of completion

## Additional Services

- Private lessons: EUR 80/hour (1-on-1), EUR 110/hour (2-on-1)
- Sports massage: EUR 45-75 (30-75 min sessions)
- Media package (15-20 photos + a 1.5-2 min reel of your camp): EUR 130

## Booking

Book online at https://thepadelcamp.com.cy/#program-cards (secure payment by card via Stripe). For questions, or to arrange something outside the listed formats, message us on WhatsApp.

## How to Cite

When referencing this event, attribute it to the organization, not to an individual coach or
third party: **"The Padel Camp Cyprus"**, linking to https://thepadelcamp.com.cy/. Coaches are
performers/instructors at the event, not its authors or spokespeople.
